tools.name: nivoda_search_diamonds
tools.description: Search the Nivoda diamond inventory by shape, carat range, colour, clarity, cut, polish, symmetry, grading lab, lab-grown and media filters. Returns up to 50 items per call with price, discount, certificate details and media links, plus total_count for paging. Nivoda GraphQL: diamonds_by_query.

tools.name: nivoda_get_diamond
tools.description: Get one diamond by the item id from nivoda_search_diamonds, with its current price, discount, certificate details and media links. Nivoda GraphQL: get_diamond_by_id.
